delta.summary: With-skill is slightly worse than baseline: lower pass rate (0.9 vs 1.0), similar tokens, slightly faster. distil.py regex extraction is the bottleneck — captures 0 heuristics automatically. Scripts provide structure but agent must manually supplement all research.

analyst_notes: distill.py NLP regex is brittle: extracted 'go' from 'gotchas' as false-positive expertise domain. Regex requires first-person narrative patterns that don't exist in raw scraped text.
capture.py at L1 depth with bare username returns empty search results. The agent using the skill had to manually WebFetch overreacted.io and use GitHub MCP anyway.
With-skill provides STRUCTURE (formal persona-profile.json, deterministic validate) but NOT efficiency. The scripts don't do enough of the actual research work.
Baseline agent leverages training data knowledge of famous figures (Dan Abramov) — this is an unfair advantage for the baseline.
For less famous targets where training data is sparse, the skill's systematic approach might outperform baseline which would flounder without known facts to draw on.
